title: Israeli Forces Arrest 39 Palestinians in West Bank Raids; Palestinian Dies from Wounds Sustained in Al-Bireh Raid
detail: Israeli forces conducted overnight raids across the West Bank, arresting 39 Palestinians. Separately, a Palestinian succumbed to wounds sustained during a prior Israeli raid on Al-Bireh, adding to the ongoing West Bank casualty toll.

title: Settlers Establish New Outpost Near Beit Iksa, Attack Home in Abu Nujeim, Cut Power Line in Masafer Yatta
detail: Israeli settlers carried out a wave of attacks and land seizures across the West Bank on Tuesday, September 15, 2026. Near Beit Iksa, northwest of occupied Jerusalem, a group of settlers under Israeli military protection began installing structures and equipment for a new outpost in the Khirbet al-Alawna area -- the second outpost established on the village's land within four months. In Abu Nujeim, southeast of Bethlehem, settlers attacked a home near the university housing area early Tuesday, leaving an elderly man and his wife with bruises. In Masafer Yatta, settlers grazed livestock on Palestinian land in the Huwara area before local women drove them off, while in nearby al-Khalil settlers cut and burned an electricity cable supplying the Wadi al-Rakhim area, causing a power outage.

title: Israeli 'Double-Tap' Drone Strike Kills Paramedic and Schoolboy in Sheikh Radwan, Gaza City
detail: An Israeli drone carried out a 'double-tap' strike in the Sheikh Radwan neighborhood of Gaza City on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, first targeting a group of Palestinians and then striking the same location again after rescuers arrived. The strikes killed Palestinian Civil Defence paramedic Sharif Shadi Labad and 15-year-old schoolboy Mohammad Abdul Zinati, and wounded several others in the second strike. Israeli forces said the initial strike targeted Hamas operatives. Gaza's Health Ministry said 6 people were killed and 71 wounded across Gaza in the preceding 24 hours, putting the toll since the October 2025 ceasefire at 1,381 killed and 4,757 wounded, and the cumulative toll since October 7, 2023 at 73,795 killed and 174,869 wounded.

media.caption: A mourner at al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza City following the deaths of paramedic Sharif Shadi Labad and 15-year-old Mohammad Abdul Zinati in an Israeli double-tap strike

confidenceReason: Deaths and 'double-tap' pattern reported by Al Jazeera citing medical sources and corroborated by Gaza Ministry of Health toll figures (Tier 1); the IDF's characterization of the target as Hamas operatives is the military's own account and not independently confirmed.

title: IDF and Shin Bet Confirm Killing of Hamas Rafah Brigade Commander Nael Abu Obeid in Southern Gaza
detail: The IDF and Shin Bet jointly confirmed late Tuesday, September 15, 2026 (announced 11:47pm local time) that a strike in the southern Gaza Strip earlier that evening killed Nael Abu Obeid, commander of Hamas's Rafah Brigade and head of the organization's military wing operations array. According to the military, Abu Obeid previously served as deputy commander of the Rafah Brigade and commander of its Tel al-Sultan and Yibna battalions, played an operational role in commanding forces during the October 7, 2023 attack, and was appointed to the top Rafah Brigade post after the killing of predecessor Mohammad Shabana in May 2025. The IDF said it used precision munitions and aerial surveillance and took steps to minimize harm to civilians. The strike followed a run of Israeli operations that officials said killed the Khan Younis Brigade commander and other senior Hamas figures earlier the same week. No Hamas confirmation of Abu Obeid's death was available at time of reporting.
